hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Standalone screens and slotted liners
function: Screens or slotted liners run across the interval without gravel, relying on the formation sand bridging on the openings.

tabs.overview: Cheaper and simpler than a gravel pack, used in openhole horizontals in well-sorted sands; public guidance warns they plug over time in most formations. Slot width is sometimes sized to the 10 percentile grain size so the coarser grains bridge.
tabs.engineering: Slot or mesh sized from sieve analysis; erosion and plugging are the design limits.
tabs.safety: Handled with protectors on the rig.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
tabs.failure_modes: Plugging, erosion, hot spots where flow concentrates.
